build.title: Codebase changes: resume details (carry on from another Claude account) + log the first edit

said.text: change-log@1 gains `resume` (repo, folder, branch, base, head, pushed, dirty, files, plan, next, notes, tests, read, pr); the hook records the git part by itself; the first edit after a prompt not worded as a change opens an entry with machine, session and session type; `changes.mjs resume <id> --prompt` + console Copy resume prompt (GET entries/{id}/resume). Still open from the log-every-change rule: a project-level hook so cloud and headless sessions log without a per-machine install.
